name: Cull Obsidian

abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Enforced Oblivion
Once Cull Obsidian's Rout Buff has expired, it goes into cool down, and can be reactivated after [30 - 10] seconds.
When Rout enters cool down, Cull's aggression is awarded with a Fury Buff, granting +[10,763.57 - 17,584.04] Attack for 4 seconds. This Buff gains +0.5 seconds duration for each hit landed while Rout was active.

abilitySections.title: Thanos's Favor - Max Persistent Charges 10
content: At the beginning of the fight, 1 Thanos's Favor Buff is gained per Persistent Charge. These Buffs last 10 seconds each and they gain effects based on the number of charges. These Buffs have their duration paused for 1 second each time an attack is landed.
Thanos has directed Cull to spread the maximum possible amount of mayhem, allowing him to start with 3 Persistant Charges in Battlegrounds or in the first fight of Alliance War.

abilitySections.title: Missions from Thanos
content: Cull Obsidian has 3 Missions to complete, which may be done in any order. Each Mission can be completed multiple times and doing so grants 1 Persistent Charge.
Mission 1: Break their Defenses: Knockout any Champion.
Mission 2: Crush their Hope: Knockout an Avenger.
Mission 3: End their Resistance: Knockout a Champion without the Combo Meter being lost due to being struck during the fight.

abilitySections.title: Thanos's Favor Buffs - Effects from Persistent Charge
content: 1+: Each Buff grants +[1,065.7] Attack.
3+: Gain an indefinite True Accuracy Passive for the duration of the Buffs.
5+: Each Buff grants +[56.12] Critical Damage Rating.
8+: Each Buff grants +5% Rout Buff duration.

abilitySections.title: On Well-Timed Blocks
content: Cull Obsidian's unique shield is able to Stun opponents with the Parry Mastery even against attacks that don't make contact.

abilitySections.title: Dash Back and Hold Block for 1.2 Seconds - Once Per Fight
content: Cull Obsidian overcharges his weapon to gain a Rout Buff for 8 seconds. This causes his opponent to suffer -100% Auto-Block Ability Accuracy and also grants his attacks an additional burst of Energy Damage equal to 120% of the damage dealt.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 75% chance per strike to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor by [1,480.77] for 14 seconds. This effect gains +5% duration and Ability Accuracy for each Persistent Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Cull Obsidian's overwhelming presence reduces the opponent's Armor Up Ability Accuracy by 100% during his Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Combat expertise grants 10 Combo Shield Buffs. When struck, 1 Combo Shield Buff is lost instead of the Combo Meter resetting. Max: 10 Combo Shield Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each strike has a 100% chance to pause personal Armor Break Debuffs on the opponent for 5 seconds.
100% chance to inflict Stun a 2 seconds Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: An influx of power from Thanos causes Cull Obsidian to re-trigger all of his Thanos' Favor Buffs.
+[1,065.7] Attack for each Persistent Charge.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Enforced Oblivion
content: Once Cull Obsidian's Rout Buff has expired, it goes into cool down, and can be reactivated after [30 - 10] seconds.

When Rout enters cool down, Cull's aggression is awarded with a Fury Buff, granting +[10,763.57 - 17,584.04] Attack for 4 seconds. This Buff gains +0.5 seconds duration for each hit landed while Rout was active.
